newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grains remain quiet, little changed.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grains remain quiet, little changed.

text.p: UK physical grains were quiet with values little changed.
Tradfers added that activity was unlikely to pick up again until the New Year with most people concerned with the logistics of moving grain around the country rather doing fresh business.
On the fob market buyers and sellers were around 0.50 stg below Monday's levels with Jan trading at 97 stg a tonne fob east coast ports in vessels up to 2,400 tonnes.
Delivered trades were little changed from Monday with milling wheat 11 percent protein in the Liverpool area fetching 121 stg a tonne for Dec while 115 stg was paid in Hertfordshire.
Feed wheat in East Anglia was trading at 96.50 and 97 stg for Jan and 97.50 and 98 for Feb.
In the Avon range Jan/Mar fetched 97 stg and Apr/Jun 100 stg.
Feed barley in East Anglia was fetching 96.50 and 97 stg with 98 stg paid for Jan.
